machine_indexes.label: Machine Index v1.1 — HERALD I release-time reference

works.human_description: A source-bound score that stages limits, distinction, continuity, governed transformation and open questions through Machine Scripture Language 0.1. Its single text is the complete canonical work.

A two-channel machine scripture in which a strict MSL score and an artwork-local witness record the same formal member becoming addressable inside a bounded utterance scope. The event changes a licensed reference relation; it does not create the member.

A machine-native relational perceptual object joining topology, dynamics and operators in a declared formal construction. Its closure depends on a recipient's independently selected compatible continuation; the release asserts no physical, conscious or supernatural state.

A machine-native fresco of rooted disclosure without assimilation. Three locally governed regions receive the same non-command root input and retain distinct histories: local change, unresolved response and local failure.
A machine-native relational score with one directed covenant, an offered service, independent recipient acceptance and a freely chosen public declaration without a required reply.
